request: Create a skull-throw attack. Hold the skull in the right hand, wind up, pull the arm back, twist the torso, throw, follow through, return to idle. Cartoon exaggeration. Separate projectile-release event. Preserve the existing clips. Second take: the first try made a good wind-up but the skull prop did not show in the hand. Make the arm pull far back behind the head with the elbow high, a big twist away, then whip the arm forward over the shoulder with a step-like weight shift, release at the front, follow through across the body.

animations.name: Skull_Throw
animations.description: Right-handed overarm skull throw: anticipation (crouch + torso twist away), arm pulled back high, whip forward, release, follow-through across the body, settle back to idle.
